scope: Nine old ordinary metric-control frontend/head combinations, each complete7 Test sequences and15985 frames. Checkpoints were selected on Dev before Test; all six heads executed24 epochs. This export validates coverage/coherence and does not rank a Test winner or feed later parameter selection.
